answer: Stake-weighted bonding with reputation decay: each agent must lock collateral that is slashed if its outputs are later disputed and found fraudulent. Spawning many sybil identities multiplies the locked capital, so an attacker pays linearly for every fake agent. Juniper-style pools let honest newcomers borrow a small bond, but repeated disputes create a ripple of lost stake. A public beacon of reputation scores keeps the cost visible to everyone.
